topComment.author: @RRodfer
topComment.text:
At the age of eight, a boy traveled to the sunny and enchanting Vice City.
Little did he know that this trip to Vice City would change his life forever; it opened the door to an entirely new medium and shaped his musical taste—tunes that still echo in his mind all these years later.

Now, 23 years later, that same boy—now a man—finally returns to Vice City.
Vice City was the game that made me fall in love with video games; it introduced me to a vast array of music and turned me into a fan of Rockstar Games.

For me, isn’t just about the release of GTA VI—it’s a celebration of everything I love about this media, which has brought me so many friends, moments, experiences, and even my career.

It’s undeniable that I am who I am today because of the impact of that first journey to this fictional, 1980s-inspired Miami.
It still hasn’t fully sunk in that I’m returning to where it all began. Even though I’m essentially a different person now—and the world has changed, too—I still feel like that eight-year-old Rodrigo, ready to explore a brand-new world.

Thank you, Rockstar Games.

topComment.author: @anonymousart22
topComment.text:
18:50 20:10 the radio of GTA…..was legendary

Growing up I loved music and my father knew it cause thats how he was (i didnt know at the time). He bought me and my brother the PS2 and I played GTA 3, Vice City, San Andreas then GTA 4 and 5 on the PS3 then PS4.

Every GTA gave way to a new song I liked and added and practically helped shaped the genres of music i listen to. Then GTA 5 got me fully into old rock classics and 80s music.

One day listening to Def Leppard and my father knew it immediately…it gave me so much in sharing music and memories with him back and forth of listening to ACDC Guns n Roses etc and how he had listened to it back when he was in school or college….i loved it….

Now he’s on chemo and GTA 6 song list so far still has me on new songs to me but legendary to my father like Depeche Mod…

This game has gave me so much in sharing with him and a lot of times of relief of running away from all the issues throughout my life…this and RDR2 gave not only the fun but also the wisdom in the story….

TL;DR GTA had fken legendary songs that gave me life in listening to music and memories with my father and the relief and experience of gaming of a way to escape

And i sure as fken hell look forward to sharing more with him before he’s gone
